# InOneShot

> InOneShot is a Windows and Android app for PDF mail merge: import a PDF template and an Excel spreadsheet, place fields (columns, dates, signatures, QR codes) by drag-and-drop directly on the PDF preview, and generate every personalized document in one click.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.inoneshot.fr/): Product overview, features, pricing, download.
- [Blog](https://www.inoneshot.fr/blog): Guides on PDF mail merge, Excel preparation, use cases.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Windows (desktop), Android (Google Play).
- Use case: generate hundreds of personalized PDFs (certificates, invoices, invitations) from a single Excel file.
- Processing is local; data never leaves the user's device.
- Free tier available; Pro license unlocks unlimited batches and advanced fields.
- Built and maintained by La Fabrik Numérique.
